mechanics.name: Inferno
mechanics.note: The fire that pulses off him while the aura is up; ranged should be out of it entirely.

mechanics.name: Explosion
mechanics.note: The detonation of his Living Bomb. It hits whoever is standing near the bomb, so the bomb runs out and the rest stay spread.

mechanics.name: Ignite Mana
mechanics.note: Magic; it burns mana and burns the player for what it took. Dispel it off the casters or they pay twice.
